# JNJ — Catalysts

## TL;DR

No actionable catalyst exists within the next 10 trading days. Q1 2026 earnings (April 14) beat all metrics but produced only a +0.5–1% reaction — a classic trapped-longs exhaustion signal fully priced. The next scheduled binary is Q2 2026 earnings (~July 15, 2026). Upcoming conference appearances (BofA Healthcare Conference May 12, Bernstein Annual Conference May 27) are near-term watch events that could move price on guidance updates. FDA Priority Review for IMAAVY (nipocalimab) is a positive pipeline signal — no PDUFA date within 10 days. Talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) remains the primary unscheduled event-risk. Risk-on macro rotation is a headwind, not a catalyst. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260501_194523.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| BofA Healthcare Conference | May 12, 2026 | Guidance update opportunity; watch for pipeline commentary on IMAAVY and Darzalex |
| Bernstein Annual Conference | May 27, 2026 | Second near-term appearance — potential positive catalyst if guidance reiterated |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 15, 2026 | Next binary — analyst Q2 EPS est. $2.84, revenue $25.01B; Stelara erosion rate and Darzalex growth are key reads |
| IMAAVY FDA review decision | TBD (Priority Review granted) | Priority Review for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia; Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 data positive for myasthenia gravis — pipeline optionality |
| Talc litigation (90,000+ lawsuits) | Unscheduled | Largest unquantifiable binary; any settlement or adverse ruling creates a gap in either direction |

## Recent news synthesis

**Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 14, 2026) — fully absorbed, muted reaction.** Revenue $24.1B (+10% YoY) and raised full-year guidance; Darzalex $4B in Q1, Tremfya $1.6B — offsetting Stelara biosimilar erosion. GAAP net income fell 52.4% driven by a large talc litigation reserve. Stock barely moved (+0.5–1%), confirming sellers absorbed the gap-up. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**FDA Priority Review for IMAAVY (nipocalimab).** Priority Review designated for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia. Phase 3 Vivacity-MG3 data show sustained efficacy in myasthenia gravis. No PDUFA date within 10 trading days — pipeline positive but not a near-term price catalyst. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**Pipeline M&A reinforcement.** $3B acquisition of Halda Therapeutics (Nov 2025) and Lexeo Therapeutics cardiac gene therapy partnership (Jan 2026) are longer-term pipeline additions. ETHICON 4000 Stapler received European CE Mark clearance (April 22). Ryan Koors named new VP Investor Relations effective May 7 (neutral). (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**Stelara biosimilar headwind — ongoing.** AbbVie and Amgen biosimilar launches for Stelara are the primary competitive headwind. The Royalty Pharma $500M Icotyde partnership is the immunology franchise recovery vehicle to watch. (Source: web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260501_194523.)

## Analyst consensus

As of May 1, 2026: Moderate Buy consensus — 11–13 Buy, 6–11 Hold, 0–1 Sell across sources. Average price target $254.93 (TipRanks), ranging from $234.30 to $254.93 depending on sample; high $285 (HSBC, March 17), low $220. Current price $229.85 sits ~10% below the $254.93 average — analyst consensus implies upside, but the downtrend indicates institutional disagreement with near-term timing. (Source: analyst_consensus, web_research/JNJ.json, run 20260501_194523.)

## Insider activity

No insider buy or sell activity recorded in the current run. Absence of insider buying is a mild bear signal relative to sector peers. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260501_194523.)
